about: The team's own subject headings for the newsroom's work, proposed to ontologist@ for review (a proposal is not an edit of the ontology). The publication's subjects are the 17 topics of data/topics/ and are not listed here. id becomes subj:<id>; use_for are the words a card's text is matched against (whole words, any case; a short upper-case word is matched in upper case only); by_call puts every card of a call class under the heading; by_path does the same for a path prefix. A card has at most three subjects. A hand file, read by the generator.
